```{r}
classes <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/njlytal/MATH314/main/classes.csv")
```

```{r}
xbar1 <- mean(classes$class1)
xbar2 <- mean(classes$class2)

n1 <- length(classes$class1)
n2 <- length(classes$class2)

s1 <- sd(classes$class1)
s2 <- sd(classes$class2)

se <- sqrt(s1^2/n1 + s2^2/n2)
alpha <- 0.05
tstar <- qt(1 - alpha/2, df = min(n1, n2) - 1)
me <- se * tstar

diffmean <- xbar2 - xbar1
(ci <- c(diffmean - me, diffmean + me))
```
